## The 55+ villages in Lakewood Ranch (and what “low CDD” likely looks like)
Because **CDD/Stewardship fees vary by exact neighborhood and even by home/site**, the only safe way to do “low CDD” is to treat these as **ranges** and verify the specific address before you buy. (LWR confirms it has a Stewardship District fee structure communitywide.) ([lakewoodranch.com](https://lakewoodranch.com/connect/faq/?utm_source=openai))

### 1) Del Webb Lakewood Ranch (55+)
- **Why it fits “lower CDD”** (relative): a commonly published range is about **$1,255–$1,640/year** (verify for the exact lot/home). ([lakewoodranchfl.blogspot.com](https://lakewoodranchfl.blogspot.com/2020/04/cdd-and-hoa-fees.html?utm_source=openai))  
- **Scale/feel:** large 55+ village (~1,300 homes), gated, active lifestyle. ([55places.com](https://www.55places.com/blog/lakewood-ranch-a-new-del-webb-community-coming-to-florida?utm_source=openai))  
- **Healthcare access:** good proximity to the LWR medical hub around University Pkwy/Lakewood Ranch Blvd (see providers below). ([lakewoodranchmedicalcenter.com](https://www.lakewoodranchmedicalcenter.com/patients-visitors/directions-and-map?utm_source=openai))  

**Best for:** “value-oriented” 55+ inside LWR where CDD is often cited as moderate-to-lower for the area.

---

### 2) Cresswind at Lakewood Ranch (55+)
- **CDD:** often cited around **$1,500/year** (again, verify by address). ([lakewoodranchfl.blogspot.com](https://lakewoodranchfl.blogspot.com/2020/04/cdd-and-hoa-fees.html?utm_source=openai))  
- **Community:** gated 55+, strong “active adult programming,” HOA shown as **$416/month** on LWR’s official page. ([lakewoodranch.com](https://lakewoodranch.com/our-villages/cresswind/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Healthcare access:** also strong, given overall LWR location and nearby hospital/ER options. ([lakewoodranchmedicalcenter.com](https://www.lakewoodranchmedicalcenter.com/patients-visitors/directions-and-map?utm_source=openai))  

**Best for:** an active-adult lifestyle with a newer feel; CDD doesn’t look “no CDD,” but often lands in a fairly predictable band.

---

### 3) Del Webb Catalina (55+) (newer)
- **Status/scale:** planned around **1,300 homes**; marketed as a major amenity campus, gated. ([lakewoodranch.com](https://lakewoodranch.com/our-villages/del-webb-catalina/?utm_source=openai))  
- **CDD:** I didn’t find a reliable, primary-source CDD number in the quick pull above—this one you’ll want to confirm from the **specific tax/estoppel** for any home you’re considering.
- **HOA (published):** **$335–$409/month** on LWR’s official page. ([lakewoodranch.com](https://lakewoodranch.com/our-villages/del-webb-catalina/?utm_source=openai))  

**Best for:** brand-new inventory and big amenities—*but you’ll need to verify the true CDD/Stewardship burden per home*.

---

## “Good healthcare access” near Lakewood Ranch (what to look for)
For convenient access from most LWR villages, two commonly used nearby options are:

- **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center** (hospital) at **8330 Lakewood Ranch Blvd, Bradenton, FL 34202** ([lakewoodranchmedicalcenter.com](https://www.lakewoodranchmedicalcenter.com/patients-visitors/directions-and-map?utm_source=openai))  
- **Sarasota Memorial ER at Lakewood Ranch** (24/7 freestanding ER with imaging/labs) at **7250 University Pkwy, Sarasota, FL 34240** ([smh.com](https://www.smh.com/Home/Locations/ER-at-Lakewood-Ranch?utm_source=openai))  

## Quick guidance on picking “low CDD”
If your priority is minimizing CDD/Stewardship:
1) **Start with Del Webb LWR and Cresswind** (they have clearer commonly-published CDD figures). ([lakewoodranchfl.blogspot.com](https://lakewoodranchfl.blogspot.com/2020/04/cdd-and-hoa-fees.html?utm_source=openai))  
2) For any specific home, ask for:
   - the **current property tax bill** (shows CDD/Stewardship line items), and
   - an **HOA estoppel** (for HOA/amenity fees).
3) If you want *truly* minimal district fees, you may need to expand beyond LWR proper—many nearby communities are **not** in a CDD, but they won’t be “in Lakewood Ranch.”

## Two questions so I can narrow this to the best matches
1) Are you trying to keep CDD/Stewardship **under a specific $/year** (e.g., under $1,500/year)?  
2) Do you want to be **within ~10 minutes** of Lakewood Ranch Medical Center/University Pkwy, or is **15–25 minutes** still “good access”?

gemini.responseText:
Finding a 55+ community in Lakewood Ranch with low CDD (Community Development District) fees can be a challenge because the master-planned infrastructure is largely funded through these assessments. However, there are specific villages and "Lakewood Ranch-adjacent" communities that offer significantly lower fees or no CDD at all.

### **1. Indigo (The Best "Low CDD" Option)**
Indigo is a gated, active-adult community (age-targeted rather than strictly restricted) that is highly sought after for its fee structure.
*   **CDD Fees:** This is one of the rare communities in Lakewood Ranch with a section of homes (built around 2016–2017) that has **no CDD fees**. Newer sections do have a CDD, but it is typically on the lower end ($1,500–$2,000/year) compared to luxury villages.
*   **Healthcare Access:** Excellent. It is roughly 7 miles from **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center** and less than 10 miles from the **Sarasota Memorial Health Care System** (Healthplex on University Pkwy).
*   **Vibe:** Maintenance-free living with a full-time lifestyle director, resort pool, and pickleball.

### **2. Del Webb Catalina (Best Low CDD for New Construction)**
As the newest 55+ community in Lakewood Ranch, Del Webb Catalina offers a more competitive CDD rate than many other new developments.
*   **CDD Fees:** Fees are approximately **$1,463 to $1,735 annually** depending on the lot size. This is lower than its sister community (Del Webb Lakewood Ranch) and many surrounding villages where CDDs often exceed $2,500.
*   **Healthcare Access:** Located in the eastern sector, it is about a 15-minute drive to **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center** and proximal to the numerous medical specialists on SR-70.
*   **Vibe:** Massive 15-acre amenity campus with a 70-acre lake, 12 pickleball courts (some covered), and a full-service bar/grill.

### **3. Del Webb Lakewood Ranch (Established & Stable)**
This was the first 55+ community in the Ranch. Because it is older and more established, its fee structure is well-defined.
*   **CDD Fees:** Generally ranges between **$1,500 and $2,000 annually**. While not "low" compared to non-master-planned areas, it is considered stable and provides high value for the established infrastructure.
*   **Healthcare Access:** This is arguably the best-located 55+ community for healthcare. It is situated very close to the **University Town Center (UTC) medical corridor** and is roughly 10 minutes from **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center**.
*   **Vibe:** Fully built-out with mature landscaping and a very active social scene with over 50 resident clubs.

### **4. Eagle Trace (The "Secret" No-CDD Alternative)**
While technically just across the border of Lakewood Ranch (near SR-64), Eagle Trace is often recommended to 55+ buyers who prioritize fee savings.
*   **CDD Fees:** **No CDD fees.** It is surrounded by Lakewood Ranch amenities but sits outside the Stewardship District boundaries.
*   **Healthcare Access:** It is minutes away from the medical offices at the northern end of Lakewood Ranch and about 15 minutes from the main hospital.
*   **Vibe:** A quiet, gated Neal Homes community with a maintenance-free lifestyle and high active-adult population, though not age-restricted.

### **Summary of Healthcare Facilities in Lakewood Ranch**
Living in any of these communities puts you within a 10–15 minute radius of the following:
*   **Lakewood Ranch Medical Center:** The primary acute care hospital (Award-winning for clinical excellence).
*   **SMH Urgent Care (University Pkwy):** High-level outpatient care and imaging.
*   **The Center for Sight:** A world-class eye care facility located right on the Ranch.
*   **Coastal Orthopedics:** Massive new facility recently opened within the community.

### **Quick Comparison Table**
| Community | 55+ Status | Est. CDD (Annual) | Hospital Proximity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Indigo** | Active Adult | $0 - $1,800 | 12-15 Minutes |
| **Del Webb Catalina** | Restricted | $1,463 - $1,735 | 15 Minutes |
| **Del Webb LWR** | Restricted | $1,500 - $2,000 | 10 Minutes |
| **Cresswind** | Restricted | $2,000 - $3,500 | 12 Minutes |
| **Eagle Trace** | Active Adult | **$0** | 15 Minutes |

**Pro Tip:** In Lakewood Ranch, CDD fees are often called "Stewardship District" fees. They are included in your property tax bill, so when looking at listings, always ask for the "non-ad valorem" tax breakdown to see the exact fee.
